headline: Small and glassy at dawn, then the sea breeze wrecks it.
today: There's a longer-period SSE pulse hinted at, pushing total wave to 3ft on the sets, and the dawn is dead calm — that early glass window is the play. It goes onshore SE by mid-morning and cross-on into the afternoon, so get it early or don't bother. Log or fish on the first of the incoming.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest day, ESE to 3ft-plus at a good angle, but cross NE wind 13-14mph all day keeps it bumpy. Size is there — just not worth the 2.5hr drive when Rockaway's cleaner.
Dropping to 1.4-2ft S but WNW cross-off in the morning makes it clean. Decent longboard session if you're already out east.
